w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Focus Group is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🗣️ Desmond to Kelsey, by the fire: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Palisade on empty shelves — 11,577 of 14,000 kcal."
They come fast and scared — a family, or what's left of one. "Please. We heard you take people in." Behind them, something worse than weather.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1000 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

windowEndGuard: not-ready:Finish the current encounter before taking your seat.
auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (22/6/7), with 1 wave-4 fought, 13 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOU ARE BACK IN THE MIDDLE — BOTH HANDS. THE PRAGMATIST'S REGISTER. I FIND IT... UNSETTLING. WHICH IS TO SAY: HUMAN."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ OUTSHONE — Arlo Pillai did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.
